review_method: Introductions/current-status/status-note read across all 35, with arc paragraph-opening topic sampling; not a fresh full-body reread of every biography
Selected complete dossier paragraphs cross-check later mentions, retrospective departures, rescues and final epilogues
Alias matches are routing candidates, not identity proof; absent literal matches do not prove absence of later scenes
No new audio, ASR comparison, original sheet/art/map, complete campaign rereading or full factual certification
Existing spelling, identity, medical/ritual mechanics, inventory and listening issues remain open
